title: Master Thief
about: A heist planner. You never pick a lock yourself — you recruit the crew, buy the gear, read the target, and decide who goes through which door. Then you watch the plan survive contact with the building, or not.

Every job is a run of encounters resolved against a d20: a difficulty class, the specialist you assigned, their attributes and equipment, and the crew's chemistry. A natural 20 opens a route nobody planned for. A natural 1 puts a name on a police file.

Between jobs the crew is the campaign. Thieves gain levels, mastery, injuries, fatigue, and grudges; equipment breaks; reputation opens better targets while notoriety brings heat down on the ones you already own.
